headline: Meeting Notes to CRM Handoff Gate: 7 Safe Checks Before Automating Follow-Up
description: A safe educational gate for owners and operators to review meeting notes before CRM updates, follow-up tasks, or automation handoffs without making legal, revenue, privacy, or guaranteed-performance claims.
claimBoundary: Educational operations guide only — not legal, compliance, privacy, security, sales, revenue, medical, financial, approval, or guaranteed-performance advice.

checks.name: Consent boundary
checks.text: Confirm the meeting-notes source is allowed for internal processing before copying anything into CRM.

checks.name: Identity match
checks.text: Match the contact, company, owner, and deal record before creating tasks or updating fields.

checks.name: Sensitive-data filter
checks.text: Remove unnecessary personal, health, financial, legal, credential, or confidential details from summaries.

checks.name: Promise control
checks.text: Separate facts from guesses; do not convert casual discussion into commitments, pricing, dates, or guarantees.

checks.name: Human owner
checks.text: Assign a named reviewer for ambiguous notes, objections, next steps, and customer-facing replies.

checks.name: Audit trail
checks.text: Keep source link, timestamp, automation rule, reviewer, and change reason visible for later review.

checks.name: Safe next action
checks.text: Create a draft task or internal reminder first; send external follow-up only after approved review.
